typography.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter font-black uppercase

layout.grid_strategy: The 'Tetris' Grid (Asymmetrical, bento layouts for projects, exposed grid lines).
layout.alignment: Strict left-alignment for copy, optical centering where needed.
layout.borders: Visible structural grid borders (1px border-zinc-200) simulating architectural blueprints. Sharp corners everywhere.

components.forms: Shadcn UI (Input, Textarea, Form, Button), heavily customized with hard square edges (rounded-none), thick borders on focus.
components.buttons: Square edges (rounded-none). Primary: bg-amber-500 text-zinc-950 hover:bg-amber-600. Outline: border-2 border-zinc-950 text-zinc-950 hover:bg-zinc-950 hover:text-white.
components.cards: Cardless approach or flat rectangles with 1px border. No soft shadows. High contrast.
components.navigation: Sticky, glassmorphism (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-zinc-200), visible on desktop. Hard bottom border.

motion.transitions: Snappy, spring-based animations. No slow fading.
motion.hover: High contrast shifts (e.g., bg-white to bg-zinc-950, text-zinc-950 to text-white).
motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling recommended for a premium heavy feel.

hero_background.description: Aerial view of a complex highway interchange with skyscrapers.
hero_background.usage: Home page hero section, full bleed with bg-black/40 overlay.

team_about.usage: About Us section -> Leadership or Team overview.

texture_bg.usage: Footer background or contact section background to add industrial texture.

specific_instructions_for_main_agent: Do NOT use typical SaaS blue or generic purple gradients.
Use a pure grid-based 'blueprint' layout. Separate sections using 1px borders (border-zinc-200).
Hero Section overlay: Use maximum bg-black/50, never darker. Ensure the highway image is clearly visible.
Buttons should have sharp, hard edges (rounded-none).
Use 'Clash Display' for headings. If unavailable, use a very wide/bold sans-serif font, never Inter.
Implement the Contact form using Shadcn UI components. Handle validation and build a backend flow (or mockup) for database submission as required.
For the dynamic projects gallery, use a CSS Grid (bento style) layout with raw HTML/Tailwind. Make it asymmetrical. Do NOT just render equal sized squares.
Ensure the navigation is sticky and visible on desktop (no hamburger menu unless on mobile).
Add test IDs (`data-testid`) to all interactive elements.
